policy.aggregation: strongest-source support/unknown; maximum contradiction across current sources
policy.semantics: model-score screening, not established truth; source trust supplied by caller

limitations: No supervision or source text enters the question/answer verbalizer.
Literal answer retention does not establish preserved meaning or all restrictions.
NLI approval does not establish answer correctness; no production admission.
All 123 pairs are known development material: 32 historical XL first-beam proposals and 91 natural response-quality development candidates. No untouched final evaluation is included.
Labels are authored assistant review, not human-validated ground truth; grammatical and omitted-restriction judgments can be subjective.
Fidelity requires preserving the proposed answer and all question restrictions. An unchanged supported premise can be incomplete; a faithfully retained proposed answer can still be wrong.
Policy acceptance measures NLI score screening, not truth, rewrite fidelity, or complete Chatbot usefulness. Nonfaithful includes incomplete, malformed, changed-meaning, and ambiguous labels.
The same source-pair calibration temperature is applied to joint evidence; joint-domain calibration is not established.
No weights, thresholds, or production routing are promoted by this diagnostic.
